news_summary: Delhi's overall AQI was 368 at 7 a.m. on Monday, a day after Diwali, with all 54 monitoring stations above 200 and 15 areas in the severe band above 400.
payoff: Severe air is forecast for the next few days, with Stage III GRAP curbs in force.
